caption: The drawing depicts a single object set against a plain, beige background. The object appears to be an oil lamp or lantern, consisting of a green, rounded, and slightly battered central container with patches where the paint has flaked off, revealing a brownish-golden color underneath. This central container is held aloft by two upward arching metallic supports, which are connected to an oval-shaped tray or base below. The base is metallic grey and features a flat, slightly concave surface with a small looped handle on one side and a larger outward-curved handle on the opposite side. A wick is visible at the top of the container, emerging from its circular opening. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition, and the object is centrally positioned on the otherwise unadorned background.
title: Whaler Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
